#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
task=/home/ec2-user/m9gd24-duckdb200-native64k-20261125
base=/mnt/nvme/builds/duckdb-native64k-20261125
exec > "$task/duckdb-build.log" 2>&1
trap 'printf "%s\n" "$?" > "$task/duckdb-build-exit.txt"' EXIT
date -u
python3.11 -m venv "$task/native-venv"
py="$task/native-venv/bin/python"
export PATH="$task/native-venv/bin:$PATH"
"$py" -m pip install 'pip>=25' 'cmake>=3.29' ninja 'scikit-build-core>=0.11.4' 'nanobind>=3.0' 'numpy>=2.0' boto3==1.44.11 PyYAML==6.0.4
if [[ ! -d "$base/duckdb-python/.git" ]]; then
  git clone --depth 1 --branch v2.0.0 --recurse-submodules --shallow-submodules https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-python.git "$base/duckdb-python"
fi
cd "$base/duckdb-python"
git rev-parse HEAD > "$task/duckdb-python-commit.txt"
git -C external/duckdb rev-parse HEAD > "$task/duckdb-core-commit.txt"
git submodule status --recursive > "$task/duckdb-submodules.txt"
export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=40
export CMAKE_ARGS='-DNATIVE_ARCH=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON'
test "$(git -C external/duckdb rev-parse HEAD)" = d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa
export OVERRIDE_GIT_DESCRIBE=v2.0.0
export OVERRIDE_DUCKDB_GIT_DESCRIBE=v2.0.0
mkdir -p "$task/wheels"
"$py" -m pip wheel --no-build-isolation --no-deps --wheel-dir "$task/wheels" .
"$py" -m pip install "$task"/wheels/duckdb-2.0.0-*.whl
"$py" - <<'PY'
import duckdb
assert duckdb.__version__=='2.0.0',duckdb.__version__
c=duckdb.connect()
assert c.execute('SELECT version()').fetchone()[0]=='v2.0.0'
print(c.execute("SELECT name,value FROM duckdb_settings() WHERE name IN ('threads','memory_limit')").fetchall())
c.execute('INSTALL httpfs; INSTALL aws; LOAD httpfs; LOAD aws;')
print('native-build-smoke-pass')
PY
find "$base/duckdb-python/build" -name CMakeCache.txt -exec grep -H '^NATIVE_ARCH:BOOL=ON$' {} \; > "$task/native-arch-cache-proof.txt"
test -s "$task/native-arch-cache-proof.txt"
sha256sum "$task"/wheels/*.whl > "$task/native-wheel-sha256.txt"
date -u

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
task=/home/ec2-user/m9gd24-duckdb200-native64k-20261125
base=/mnt/nvme/builds/duckdb-native64k-20261125
exec > "$task/kernel-build.log" 2>&1
trap 'printf "%s\n" "$?" > "$task/kernel-build-exit.txt"' EXIT
date -u
sudo dnf install -y patch python3-devel
rpmbuild -bp --nodeps --target aarch64 --define "_topdir $base/kernel-rpm" "$base/kernel-rpm/SPECS/kernel6.12.spec"
source_dir=$(find "$base/kernel-rpm/BUILD" -maxdepth 2 -type d -name 'linux-6.12.115*' | head -n 1)
test -f "$source_dir/Makefile"
make -C "$source_dir" mrproper
printf '%s\n' "$source_dir" > "$task/kernel-source-dir.txt"
out="$base/kernel-out"
mkdir -p "$out"
cp "/boot/config-$(uname -r)" "$task/kernel-config-original"
cp "$task/kernel-config-original" "$out/.config"
"$source_dir/scripts/config" --file "$out/.config" -d ARM64_4K_PAGES -d ARM64_16K_PAGES -e ARM64_64K_PAGES --set-str LOCALVERSION '-native64k-exp-20261125' --set-str SYSTEM_TRUSTED_KEYS '' --set-str SYSTEM_REVOCATION_KEYS ''
make -C "$source_dir" O="$out" olddefconfig
grep -q '^CONFIG_ARM64_64K_PAGES=y$' "$out/.config"
cp "$out/.config" "$task/kernel-config-64k"
diff -u "$task/kernel-config-original" "$task/kernel-config-64k" > "$task/kernel-config.diff" || true
make -C "$source_dir" O="$out" -j48 Image modules
make -s -C "$source_dir" O="$out" kernelrelease > "$task/kernel-release.txt"
sha256sum "$out/arch/arm64/boot/Image" "$out/.config" > "$task/kernel-build-sha256.txt"
date -u

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
task=/home/ec2-user/m9gd24-duckdb200-native64k-20261125
base=/mnt/nvme/builds/duckdb-native64k-20261125
exec > "$task/kernel-install.log" 2>&1
trap 'printf "%s\n" "$?" > "$task/kernel-install-exit.txt"' EXIT
test "$(cat "$task/kernel-build-exit.txt")" = 0
release=$(cat "$task/kernel-release.txt")
case "$release" in 6.12.115-native64k-exp-20261125) ;; *) printf 'Unexpected kernel release: %s\n' "$release"; exit 1;; esac
source_dir=$(cat "$task/kernel-source-dir.txt")
out="$base/kernel-out"
uname -r > "$task/kernel-before-reboot.txt"
getconf PAGESIZE > "$task/page-size-before.txt"
sudo grubby --info=ALL > "$task/boot-entries-before.txt"
sudo grubby --default-kernel > "$task/default-kernel-before.txt"
sudo mdadm --detail --scan > "$task/raid-before.txt"
sudo blkid /dev/md127 > "$task/filesystem-before.txt"
cat /proc/cmdline > "$task/cmdline-before.txt"
sudo make -C "$source_dir" O="$out" INSTALL_MOD_STRIP=1 modules_install
sudo install -m 644 "$out/arch/arm64/boot/Image" "/boot/vmlinuz-$release"
sudo install -m 644 "$out/System.map" "/boot/System.map-$release"
sudo install -m 644 "$out/.config" "/boot/config-$release"
sudo depmod "$release"
sudo dracut --force --kver "$release" --add-drivers 'nvme nvme_core ena xfs md_mod raid0' "/boot/initramfs-$release.img"
sudo grubby --add-kernel="/boot/vmlinuz-$release" --initrd="/boot/initramfs-$release.img" --copy-default --title="Amazon Linux 64 KiB experiment ($release)"
sudo grubby --update-kernel="/boot/vmlinuz-$release" --remove-args='rd.emergency rd.shell' --args='panic=30 rd.emergency=reboot'
sudo grubby --info="/boot/vmlinuz-$release" > "$task/boot-entry-64k.txt"
sudo grubby --default-kernel > "$task/default-kernel-after-install.txt"
cmp "$task/default-kernel-before.txt" "$task/default-kernel-after-install.txt"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
task=Path('/home/ec2-user/m9gd24-duckdb200-native64k-20261125')
lines=(task/'boot-entry-64k.txt').read_text().splitlines()
entry=next(line.split('=',1)[1].strip('"') for line in lines if line.startswith('id='))
assert entry.endswith('6.12.115-native64k-exp-20261125'),entry
subprocess.run(['sudo','grub2-reboot',entry],check=True)
(task/'one-time-boot-id.txt').write_text(entry+'\n')
PY
sudo grub2-editenv list > "$task/grubenv-before-reboot.txt"
sha256sum "/boot/vmlinuz-$release" "/boot/initramfs-$release.img" "/boot/config-$release" > "$task/installed-kernel-sha256.txt"
sync
date -u
printf 'Installed and prepared one-time 64 KiB boot; original kernel remains the default fallback.\n'

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ORIGINAL = Path('/home/ec2-user/m9gd24-duckdb200-native64k-20261125')
RECIPE = ORIGINAL / 'reproducer/bench/m9gd/duckdb-2.0-s3/reproduce.py'
MODULE_SHA = '50f4434f90be08ac3d188ad895b01795a5058ca0ce8a9b7e6ecfd3f0b39d7fda'

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def main():
    import _duckdb
    assert os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE') == 65536
    assert os.uname().release == '6.12.115-native64k-exp-20261125'
    assert digest(Path(_duckdb.__file__)) == MODULE_SHA
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    (ROOT / 'started-utc.txt').write_text(started + '\n')
    import types
    recipe_source = RECIPE.read_text()
    assert recipe_source.count('318617491865') == 2
    recipe_source = recipe_source.replace('318617491865', '274877906944')
    recipe_source = recipe_source.replace('296.7 GiB', '256.0 GiB')
    recipe_source = recipe_source.replace('fixed_baseline_memory_limit_bytes', 'fixed_memory_limit_bytes')
    recipe_source = recipe_source.replace('exact baseline memory limit', 'user-approved 256 GiB memory limit')
    (ROOT / 'recipe-256gib.py').write_text(recipe_source)
    recipe = types.ModuleType('recipe_memory256')
    recipe.__file__ = str(RECIPE)
    exec(compile(recipe_source, str(RECIPE) + ' (256 GiB variant)', 'exec'), recipe.__dict__)
    original_stage, original_save = recipe.stage, recipe.save

    def stage(sources, directory, spill):
        changes = original_stage(sources, directory, spill)
        controller = directory / 'run.py'
        text = controller.read_text()
        replacements = {
            'for query in range(1,23):': 'for query in (12,):',
            'len(values)==22': 'len(values)==1',
            'len(measured)==44': 'len(measured)==2',
            'for q in range(1,query+1):': 'for q in [v for v in (12,) if v<=query]:',
            'Q1 Q1 clear/restart Q2 Q2 clear/restart ... Q22 Q22': 'Q12 Q12',
        }
        for before, after in replacements.items():
            assert text.count(before) == 1, before
            text = text.replace(before, after, 1)
        compile(text, str(controller), 'exec')
        controller.write_text(text)
        return {**changes, 'retry_queries': [12], 'controller_changes': replacements,
                'worker_changes_beyond_original_native64_adapter': 'memory limit reduced to 274877906944 bytes (256 GiB), user approved'}

    def save(path, value):
        if path.name == 'replay-plan.json':
            value = {**value, 'ordering': 'Q12 Q12',
                     'retry_queries': [12], 'original_campaign': str(ORIGINAL),
                     'purpose': 'Run Q12 twice with user-approved 256 GiB memory budget after repeated OS OOM at 296.7 GiB.'}
        original_save(path, value)

    recipe.stage, recipe.save = stage, save
    sys.argv = [str(RECIPE), '10000', '--output', str(ROOT / 'run')]
    code = recipe.main()
    assert digest(Path(_duckdb.__file__)) == MODULE_SHA
    original_save(ROOT / 'native-proof.json', dict(module_sha256=MODULE_SHA,
                  source_campaign=str(ORIGINAL), page_size=os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE'),
                  kernel=os.uname().release, started_utc=started, exit_code=code,
                  recipe_sha256=digest(RECIPE), executed_recipe_sha256=digest(ROOT/'recipe-256gib.py'), memory_limit_bytes=274877906944, memory_change_user_approved=True, retry_sha256=digest(Path(__file__))))
    return code

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
